@dataclass
class ProxyEndpoint:
    """Một proxy trong bể xoay vòng."""

    url: str
    region: str = "auto"
    protocol: str = "http"
    fail_count: int = 0
    last_success_ts: Optional[float] = None
    is_banned: bool = False
    avg_latency_ms: float = 300.0

    def mark_success(self, latency_ms: float) -> None:
        self.last_success_ts = time.time()
        self.fail_count = max(0, self.fail_count - 1)
        self.avg_latency_ms = 0.8 * self.avg_latency_ms + 0.2 * latency_ms
        self.is_banned = False

    def mark_failure(self) -> None:
        self.fail_count += 1
        if self.fail_count >= 3:
            self.is_banned = True

    @property

    def hash_key(self) -> str:
        raw = f"{self.platform}|{self.title}|{self.price_retail_vnd}"
        return hashlib.md5(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


# ===========================================================================
# LỚP 1 — ROTATING PROXY MANAGER
# ===========================================================================
class ProxyRotationManager:
    """
    Xoay vòng proxy theo cơ chế round-robin kết hợp health-check.
    - proxy bị ban 3 lần thất bại liên tiếp sẽ bị cách ly (is_banned=True)
    - Ưu tiên proxy có latency thấp và fail_count thấp.
    - Hỗ trợ nạp proxy từ file text (mỗi dòng một proxy).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        proxy_list: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
        proxy_file: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._pool: List[ProxyEndpoint] = []
        self._cursor = 0
        self.load_proxies(proxy_list, proxy_file)

    def load_proxies(
        self,
        proxy_list: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
        proxy_file: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        candidates: List[str] = []
        if proxy_list:
            candidates.extend(proxy_list)
        if proxy_file and os.path.exists(proxy_file):
            with open(proxy_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                candidates.extend(
                    line.strip()
                    for line in f
                    if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")
                )
        for raw in candidates:
            proto = "http"
            if raw.startswith(("http://", "https://", "socks5://")):
                proto = raw.split("://", 1)[0]
                raw = raw.split("://", 1)[1]
            url = f"{proto}://{raw}"
            if not any(p.url == url for p in self._pool):
                self._pool.append(ProxyEndpoint(url=url, protocol=proto))
        if not self._pool:
            # fallback: không dùng proxy (direct)
            self._pool.append(
                ProxyEndpoint(url="", protocol="none")
            )
        logger.info("[Proxy] Loaded %d proxies (0 = direct).", len(self._pool))

    def get_next(self) -> ProxyEndpoint:
        """Lấy proxy khả dụng tiếp theo (bỏ qua proxy bị ban)."""
        with self._lock:
            n = len(self._pool)
            if n == 0:
                return ProxyEndpoint(url="", protocol="none")
            for _ in range(n):
                p = self._pool[self._cursor % n]
                self._cursor = (self._cursor + 1) % n
                if not p.is_banned:
                    return p
            # tất cả bị ban → trả direct và reset ban sau 60s
            for p in self._pool:
                p.is_banned = False
            return self._pool[0]

    def report_success(self, proxy: ProxyEndpoint, latency_ms: float) -> None:
        proxy.mark_success(latency_ms)

    def report_failure(self, proxy: ProxyEndpoint) -> None:
        proxy.mark_failure()
        if proxy.is_banned:
            logger.warning("[Proxy] BANNED: %s", proxy.url)

    def stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "total": len(self._pool),
            "banned": sum(1 for p in self._pool if p.is_banned),
            "active": sum(1 for p in self._pool if not p.is_banned),
        }
